note: Press coverage shown on news.html, grouped one entry per paper. To add coverage of a new paper, copy an entry anywhere in the array — the renderer sorts by date, newest first. Required: `date` (YYYY-MM, the paper's issue date from the CV — it renders as the tail of a citation, not as the press date) and `headline` (written in English; the site is English-only). Optional: `related` (the journal name), `image` (the paper's TOC figure under assets/news/) with `image_alt` describing the graphic, and `thumb` (text for a generated tile when there is no image, e.g. "ACS Nano" renders as ACS over NANO). Each entry in `outlets` needs `name` and `url`; add `kind`: "video" for broadcast segments. (`language` is also supported but deliberately unused — labelling the Korean articles was dropped.) To add one more outlet to a paper already listed, just append to its `outlets` array.
